projecthero.guide.starfire.titans.body: Within 32 blocks of a squadmate who is also a Titan (Starfire, Beast Boy, Raven or Cyborg), you hit 10% harder and your Starbolt bar refills 20% faster. A red-and-gold T next to the hotbar shows it's on.
projecthero.guide.raven.titans.body: Within 32 blocks of a squadmate who is also a Titan (Starfire, Beast Boy, Raven or Cyborg), you hit 10% harder and Dark Energy refills 20% faster. A red-and-gold T next to the hotbar shows it's on.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.titans.body: Within 32 blocks of a squadmate who is also a Titan (Starfire, Beast Boy, Raven or Cyborg), you hit 10% harder and Morph Stamina refills 20% faster. A red-and-gold T next to the hotbar shows it's on.
projecthero.guide.cyborg.titans.body: Within 32 blocks of a squadmate who is also a Titan (Starfire, Beast Boy, Raven or Cyborg), you hit 10% harder and your core charges 20% faster. A red-and-gold T next to the hotbar shows it's on.
